headline: The 99 Names of God, from entry to detail
overview: Draw a divine name each day for spiritual reflection and guidance. Explore the 99 Names of God (Asma ul-Husna) with meanings, pronunciation, and contemplative prompts to deepen spiritual awareness.
targetAudience: Users interested in spirituality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Draw a divine name each day for spiritual contemplation
Explore all 99 Names of God with Arabic text, transliteration, and meaning
Receive daily reflection prompts inspired by each name's essence
Track your journey through the names over time
tips: Sit quietly for a few minutes after drawing your daily name — let its meaning settle before reading the reflection prompt.
Try to carry the essence of the day's name with you throughout the day as an intention or mantra.
